faqs.q: What are American Mobile Power steel sidemount hydraulic reservoir tanks used for?
faqs.a: American Mobile Power steel sidemount hydraulic reservoir tanks hold the oil for a mobile hydraulic system, mounted at the side of the machine. Six sizes are listed, from 7 to 40 gallons; the full range is on the [reservoirs and breathers shelf](/c/hydraulic-reservoirs-breathers).

faqs.q: Which American Mobile Power reservoir part number is which size?
faqs.a: The part number carries the size: A3107 is 7 gallons, A3100 is 10 gallons, A3150 is 15 gallons, A3250 is 25 gallons, A3300 is 30 gallons and A3400 is 40 gallons. Quote the A-number from the tank you are replacing.

faqs.q: What capacities do American Mobile Power steel sidemount tanks come in?
faqs.a: The rows give 7, 10, 15, 25, 30 and 40 gallon steel tanks. A common rule of thumb sizes an industrial open-circuit reservoir at about three times pump flow per minute, and less on mobile machines.

faqs.q: How big a tank do I need for a mobile hydraulic system?
faqs.a: Size it from the pump flow: the rule of thumb is about three times pump flow per minute for an industrial open-circuit reservoir, and less on mobile machines. Pick the nearest listed size from 7 to 40 gallons that covers your circuit.
